messages:
Maria G: Running a quick 7-day experiment on the pricing page — goal: see if a concise calculator + tightened FAQ decreases sign-up friction and raises demo CTAs. Target cohort: new trial signups this week. :eyes:
AJ: love it. what’s the success metric? MQLs or demo CTR?
Maria G: Primary = demo CTA clicks / pageview. Secondary = demo form completion (MQLs). Benchmark last month: demo CTR 3.1% on pricing. Want +1.5pp.
Sanjay: quick note on inbound routing — if someone clicks demo from the experiment, tag with `pricing_microcopy_v2` and route to AE queue A (low-touch) initially. If they fill form with company size >100, escalate to AE queue B.
Tara: copy variants? do we need legal sign-off for new FAQ phrasing?
Maria G: Two variants: A (baseline): current calculator copy. B (concise): "Estimate your monthly inference cost — enter tokens/day & model tier." Short FAQ tidbits (inline toggles) instead of long paragraphs. No legal language changes, just tone + structure.
AJ: can you paste the copy?
Maria G: Sure — Variant B snippets:
```
Calculator headline: "How much will inference cost?"
Subhead: "Estimate monthly cost based on tokens/day and model tier — quick and private."
CTA: "Estimate my cost"
FAQ toggle 1: "What affects cost?" -> "Requests/sec, sequence length, and model family."
FAQ toggle 2: "Do you store prompts?" -> "No. We keep only ephemeral request metadata unless you opt-in."
```
Ken: short + clear. Suggest change CTA to "See an estimate" (less salesy).
Sanjay: routing works. Devs — can you add the `pricing_microcopy_v2` query param for tracking? Also pass `experiment=compact_calc_v1`.
Luis-bot: deploy-preview ready at https://preview.redwood.dev/pricing?experiment=compact_calc_v1 (build 1873).
Tara: timeline? we can ship the preview to a subset (10% of traffic) and tie to GA event `pricing_demo_click`.
Maria G: plan: QA today, 10% traffic roll tomorrow morning PDT, run 7 full days, check results on Monday. Will capture demo CTR, demo form conversion, and support tickets referencing pricing.
AJ: A/B test variant allocation?
Maria G: 50/50 split. If variance low by day 3, bump to 25/75 favoring winner.
Ken: small ask for devs — make FAQ toggles keyboard accessible and include analytics on toggle opens (event: `faq_toggle_open`, label: `compact_calc_v1`).
Sanjay: after 7 days, if demo CTR +1.5pp and MQL uplift, we'll keep copy and push to 100% and update inbound routing to AE queue B for medium accounts.
Tara: webinar tie-in idea — "Ask us about cost optimization" CTA on the experiment will route to a short webinar signup modal. Want to run a single webinar next Thurs if results look promising.
Maria G: yes — we’ll prep a short benchmark narrative for the webinar showing latency vs cost tradeoffs and how the calculator models expected spend for common workloads. AJ can you own the slide with demo numbers?
AJ: on it.
Ken: devs — ping me if there are any accessibility regressions during rollout.
Maria G: final asks: design review done, dev review done, legal ok. @AJ please approve copy; @Ken and @Sanjay confirm tracking & routing set. If all green, I’ll flip 10% tomorrow 10:30am PDT. :thumbsup:
